title: PMFS 136, the Master Compact pointer and mouse driver
notes: The file $.WIMPS.R.PMFS (load and execution address &FFFF8000, 8,192 bytes) on the Acorn BBC Master Compact Welcome disc, extracted with oaknut-disc. A 65C02 sideways ROM image that the Welcome disc's $.Loader puts in sideways RAM bank 5 with *SRLOAD. The ROM identifies itself as PMFS 136, (C)1986 PMF. The disc is titled "Welcome 1.03C Iss4". Later Welcome discs carry a 6 KB build of PMFS 136 instead.
